decisions.reason: The charting bundle received visible launch publicity and rapid releases, so management still feels committed to it, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 suggests it may be fading or folded into map.apps.

As the flagship platform central to the firm's announced direction, sunk investment and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely, and weak visibility can be attributed to rebranding or integration.
The field data capture software fits the core offer and had its own page, so management will attribute weak results to temporary adoption delays, despite its recent absence from the website.
The search extension is a small add-on tied to the committed web map ecosystem, so it is likely kept, although its low visibility since 2020 raises the risk of quiet withdrawal.
